status_note: Semantic membership oracle. The active raw-formula execution mirror is references/set-membership-active; this file remains pending because it records caller/reference membership expectations rather than executable probe formulas.
description: Set-producing operators (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §3.5, §3.5b, §3.6) — which node-set each resolves to from a given caller, and order where it matters. Complements references/classification (which only pins single-vs-set cardinality). Carried as set-membership references (§3.7, §6 items 1/3); membership invalidates on structural change.

cases.name: .* yields the resolved node's children
cases.note: Q1 resolves by walk-up; .* is its children in sibling order.

cases.name: @ANCESTORS yields enclosing nodes, closest first
cases.note: Closest-first, up to the named top-level node. The unnamed workspace root is reached via [] (§3.2), not enumerated here.

cases.name: @PRECEDING yields earlier siblings in order
cases.note: Net is sibling-index 2 under Q1 [Income, Margin, Net]; preceding = the two earlier siblings.

cases.name: @PRECEDING of the first sibling is the empty set
cases.note: Income is the first sibling; an empty collection is a valid resolution, not Unresolved.

cases.name: Foo.**.Bar gathers matching nodes at any depth
cases.note: Every Margin at any depth under 2005.

cases.name: Foo.** gathers every descendant
cases.note: All descendants of Q2 (it has no deeper nesting here).
